Develop event configurations and seating plans in collaboration with hirers, production teams, ticketing, SSG and relevant stakeholders. Develop the Concert Event Management Plan and associated event-coordination protocols for each event, ensuring clear timelines, responsibilities, approvals and escalation procedures. Ensure safety briefings, inductions and required safety training are completed for each event by relevant Live Nation personnel, contractors and event-day staff. Coordinate the stage-safety inspection schedule with hirers and production teams, ensuring inspections, approvals and remedial actions are completed in accordance with agreed procedures. Coordinate technical production requirements, backstage operations, artist areas, venue access and event logistics in line with the agreed division of responsibilities. Ensure contractor scopes, service levels, schedules, briefing materials and performance standards support safe, high-quality event delivery. Control Room & Event Communications Establish and lead the event-control-room structure and operating protocols, coordinating building management, fire-alarm management and Fire Services, security and CCTV including Police services, cleaning, ticketing, medical, transport and other relevant event functions. Ensure operational logs, incident records, control-room reports and relevant event documentation are completed accurately and retained in accordance with agreed requirements. Operational Documentation & Continuous Improvement Develop and maintain the Operations and Maintenance Manual, Technical Manual and technical pack/venue guide, in coordination with SSG, the Dome owner/operator and relevant technical stakeholders. Develop and maintain event-operating procedures, checklists, staffing plans, risk-assessment templates, event briefings and client-handover materials. Establish structured post-event analysis across safety, operational performance, staffing, client feedback, guest experience and financial outcomes. Use operational insights to improve efficiency, safety, customer satisfaction, service delivery and stakeholder relationships. Team Leadership & Development Lead, mentor and develop the core Event Operations & Management team, ensuring clear objectives, accountability and high standards of delivery. Work closely with the Live Nation Korea HR Manager on recruitment, workforce planning, training and people matters for agreed Dome event-operations roles. Coordinate the planning, briefing and deployment of Live Nation event-day staff, contractors and other agreed operational resources. Establish and maintain training programmes for event personnel covering operational procedures, emergency response, guest services, crowd management and event-day communications. Foster a collaborative, safety-led and solutions-focused culture across the Dome event-delivery team. Proven experience planning and delivering large-scale concerts, festivals, touring events, sporting events or other complex live events. Strong understanding of event operations, production logistics, venue configurations, crowd management, emergency planning and event-day command structures. Good knowledge of Korean event regulations, licensing, health and safety, disaster and safety-management requirements and relevant approval processes. Experience developing event-management plans, risk assessments, operating procedures and event-delivery documentation. Demonstrated ability to manage contractors, operational suppliers, casual staff and event-day teams, and to work effectively with promoters, hirers, touring productions, ticketing providers, security providers and public authorities. Commercially aware, with experience managing event budgets, safety costs, operational recharges and vendor costs. Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm and decisive in high-pressure situations. Fluency in verbal and written Korean and English, with proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant event-management or venue-operations systems. Flexible to work evenings, weekends and public holidays, and to travel as required by the event calendar.
